# Nicholas Napoli, Esq. | Fort Lauderdale Waterfront Realtor

> Nicholas Napoli, Esq. is a Realtor with Fidelity Real Estate LLC in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. He works with waterfront, residential and commercial real estate in Fort Lauderdale, Pompano Beach and Broward County in South Florida. He is also a residential waterfront developer and a practicing attorney, a member of The Florida Bar. Real estate services are not legal services.

- Phone: (954) 815-8278
- Email: nicknapolire@gmail.com
- Website: https://laudyrealestate.com
- Profiles: [Zillow](https://www.zillow.com/profile/nicknapolire), [Traded](https://traded.co/agent/nick-napoli/)

Recent sales he represented: a $7,250,000 waterfront home in Coral Ridge, Fort Lauderdale (buyer, April 2026) and a $3,375,000 condominium at Solemar, Pompano Beach (seller, August 2026). He has been profiled in Lifestyle magazine (Lifestyle Media Group, Fort Lauderdale), including its Men of Influence feature.

## About

- [About Nicholas Napoli, Esq.](https://laudyrealestate.com/about): bio, featured transactions, client reviews and press.

## Guides

- [Fort Lauderdale Waterfront Buyer's Guide](https://laudyrealestate.com/waterfront): what to check before buying on the water: depth at low tide, canal width and distance to the ocean, bridge clearance, setbacks, seawall inspections and questions to ask the seller. Cites Florida statutes, the Fort Lauderdale code and federal drawbridge rules.
- [How to Choose a Fort Lauderdale Neighborhood](https://laudyrealestate.com/neighborhoods): five neighborhoods compared by age, setting and water access.
- [Las Olas Isles](https://laudyrealestate.com/las-olas-isles): 1920s finger isles off East Las Olas Boulevard; canal homes with only drawbridges between them and the inlet.
- [Harbor Beach](https://laudyrealestate.com/harbor-beach): guard-gated waterfront neighborhood between the Intracoastal and the ocean, one drawbridge from Port Everglades.
- [Coral Ridge](https://laudyrealestate.com/coral-ridge): about 1,350 homes between the Middle River and the Intracoastal.
- [Rio Vista](https://laudyrealestate.com/rio-vista): 1920s neighborhood on the New River and the Intracoastal, next to downtown.
- [Victoria Park](https://laudyrealestate.com/victoria-park): walkable 1925 neighborhood next to downtown and Las Olas.
- [Fort Lauderdale History in Photographs](https://laudyrealestate.com/history): archive photographs of the New River, Las Olas Boulevard, the beach and Rio Vista from History Fort Lauderdale, plus 1906–1907 newspaper coverage of Everglades drainage.
